agent_id.description: The Letta agent ID. Only needed to start a new conversation with that agent (conversation_id: null) or to reach its default conversation (conversation_id: "default").

conversation_id.description: The conversation to send to, such as the Conversation ID returned by Agent (Letta agents and external coding agents). Use null to start a new conversation with agent_id or, as a subagent, to message your parent.

computer.description: Optional computer where the recipient should run: cloud, an online computer name, or its stable device ID. Omitted, null, and blank values use its active computer or saved destination (a computer or Cloud sandbox). An offline saved computer does not trigger a Cloud-sandbox fallback.
